This page is a list of official turning points, not a news feed.

Read the one-line note under each heading, then the dates.

“In force” means the instrument applies now. “Draft” or “guidance” means it does not yet bind operators by itself.

Hong Kong rules apply to this course. Mainland, United States, and EU rows are comparators.

## Hong Kong

These dates created Hong Kong’s working definition, the drone statute, two trial programmes, and the 1.4 GHz licence. The Action Plan text is still unpublished.

- 2022-12-01 — Cap. 448G full effect. Small Unmanned Aircraft Order took full effect as Hong Kong’s main SUA statute. [source](https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G)
- 2024 (PA ¶82) — 2024 Policy Address — LAE / Working Group. Chief Executive announced establishment of the Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy and the LAE policy track (¶82). [source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/en/p81.html)
- 2024-11-12 — Working Group first meeting. Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy held its first meeting. [source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202411/12/P2024111200260.htm)
- 2025-03-20 — Regulatory Sandbox selection. Government announced selection of **38** of **72** first-cohort Regulatory Sandbox projects (do **not** blend with Sandbox X). [source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm)
- 2025-07-18 — Cap. 448G Category C. Category C SUA (above 25 kg up to 150 kg) amendments took effect. [source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/17/P2025071700590.htm)
- 2025-10-27 — 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence. Communications Authority / OFCA UAS (Private) Licence for **1430–1444 MHz**, confined to LAE Regulatory Sandbox projects, became available. [source](https://www.ofca.gov.hk/en/industry_focus/industry_focus/uas_private_licence/index.html)
- 2025-11-24 — Regulatory Sandbox X launch. Advanced Regulatory Sandbox X launched (separate programme from the first Sandbox). [source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm)
- 2025 (PA ¶153–157) — 2025 Policy Address — LAE / Action Agenda. PA committed to formulate the LAE planning Action Agenda, Sandbox X, spectrum, and related infrastructure language (¶153–157). [source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html)
- 2025-12-31 — Civil Aviation Department (CAD) Advisory Circular (AC)-013 (current PDF). Current CAD Advisory Circular on BVLOS permissions **within Regulatory Sandbox** (supersedes 2025-07-18 version). [source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf)
- 2026-04-24 — CAD AC-017 (current PDF). Current CAD Advisory Circular on cross-boundary SUA permissions **within Regulatory Sandbox X**. [source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-017.pdf)

## Mainland

These dates are Mainland law or drafts. They do not replace Cap. 448G in Hong Kong.

- 2023-12-21 — National Airspace Basic Classification. CAAC released the national airspace basic classification (incl. G / W labels) — **not Hong Kong law**. [source](http://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202312/t20231221_222397.html)
- 2024-01-01 — 国令761. Interim UAS Flight Management Ordinance took effect. [source](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202306/content_6888800.htm)
- 2024-01-01 — CCAR-92. Civil UAS Operation Safety Rules took effect. [source](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/2020/jigou/fgs/202401/t20240103_3980642.html)
- 2025-12-22 — NDRC LAE statistical classification. NDRC issued 发改低空〔2025〕1676号,《低空经济及其核心产业统计分类（试行）》. [source](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7052866.htm)
- 2025-12-27 — Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision) — passage / promulgation. NPC Standing Committee revised Civil Aviation Law (Order No. 65 path); CAAC publishes the revised text. [source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/FLFG/202512/t20251227_229597.html)
- 2026-07-01 — Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision) — effective. Revised Civil Aviation Law took effect. [source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/FLFG/202512/t20251227_229597.html)
- 2026-08-11 — CAAC ATM Rules (征求意见稿) Ch.12 (draft). CAAC published draft ATM rules consultation text including unmanned-aircraft chapter — **not promulgated law** (comments to 2026-09-11). [source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202608/t20260811_231462.html)

## United States

Early rows are studies and concepts. 2024–2025 rows are FAA rules for powered-lift pilots and operations. “Powered-lift” is the FAA category closest to many eVTOL designs.

- 2018-11-21 — NASA UAM Market Study (BAH final). NASA-sponsored Urban Air Mobility Market Study final report submitted / published on NTRS (course constraint framing; **no market-size figures copied here**). [source](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20190001472/downloads/20190001472.pdf)
- 2021-01-15 — Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Remote ID final rule (Federal Register (FR) publication). FAA Remote Identification of Unmanned Aircraft final rule published in the Federal Register (86 FR 4390). [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2021/01/15/2020-28948/remote-identification-of-unmanned-aircraft)
- 2023-04-26 — FAA UAM Concept of Operations v2.0. FAA published Urban Air Mobility Concept of Operations Version 2.0. [source](https://www.faa.gov/sites/faa.gov/files/Urban-Air-Mobility-Concept-of-Operations-2.0.pdf)
- 2024-11-21 — Integration of Powered-Lift final rule (89 FR 92296; Doc. 2024-24886). FAA published the Powered-Lift pilot certification and operations final rule (new 14 CFR part 194 / SFAR No. 120 and related amendments). [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2024/11/21/2024-24886/integration-of-powered-lift-pilot-certification-and-operations-miscellaneous-amendments-related-to)
- 2025-01-21 — Powered-Lift final rule — general effective date. Final rule becomes effective (except amendatory instruction 52, effective 2025-07-21 per FR DATES text). [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2024/11/21/2024-24886/integration-of-powered-lift-pilot-certification-and-operations-miscellaneous-amendments-related-to)
- 2025-07-24 — MOSAIC final rule — Modernization of Special Airworthiness Certification (90 FR 35034; Doc. 2025-13972). FAA published the MOSAIC final rule amending light-sport manufacture, certification, operation, and maintenance rules. [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/07/24/2025-13972/modernization-of-special-airworthiness-certification)
- 2025-10-22 — MOSAIC — first effective slice. FR DATES: rule effective this date except listed amendatory instructions deferred to 2026-07-24 (pilot/repairman/ops and related provisions in this slice). [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/07/24/2025-13972/modernization-of-special-airworthiness-certification)
- 2026-07-24 — MOSAIC — deferred application / effective slice. FR DATES: amendatory instructions 3, 8, 9, 13, 15, 17, 21, 23–26, 71, 72, 75, 76, and 80 effective this date (airworthiness-certification and related remaining provisions). [source](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/07/24/2025-13972/modernization-of-special-airworthiness-certification)

## European Union

2021–2023 created U-space (the EU traffic-management framework for drones). Later rows are EASA technical conditions for VTOL aircraft and crew, not a new U-space regulation.

- 2021-04-22 (adopted) / 2021-04-23 (OJ) — Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 — U-space. Commission adopted the U-space regulatory framework; published in the Official Journal (L 139). [source](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32021R0664)
- 2023-01-26 — (EU) 2021/664 application date. U-space Implementing Regulation **applies** from this date across the Union (per Art. 19). [source](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32021R0664)
- 2019-07-02 — European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) SC-VTOL-01 (Issue 1). EASA issued Special Condition SC-VTOL-01 airworthiness standards for small-category person-carrying VTOL aircraft. [source](https://www.easa.europa.eu/sites/default/files/dfu/SC-VTOL-01.pdf)
- 2025-07-07 — EASA ED Decision 2025/011/R. EASA Executive Director Decision issuing AMC & GM to Regulation (EU) No 1178/2011 for innovative air mobility with **manned VTOL-capable aircraft**. [source](https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/document-library/agency-decisions/ed-decision-2025011r)
